summary.text: Matthew Schindler is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 2B, in Washington County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An information technology and cybersecurity professional and former Hagerstown city councilmember, he has served in the House since January 2025.

paragraphs.text: Schindler was born in Hagerstown, graduated from North Hagerstown High School in 2001, and studied at Hagerstown Community College before earning a B.S. in computer networks and cyber security from the University of Maryland in 2021.

His career includes work as a network specialist at the Washington County Department of Social Services, an information technology manager at National Capital Bank of Washington, and a systems administrator at Leidos; since 2022 he has been vice president of IT and cyber security manager at National Capital Bank of Washington.
Schindler served on the Hagerstown Ethics Commission from 2021 to 2023 and on the City of Hagerstown council in 2023-2024.

He has been a member of the House of Delegates since January 7, 2025, and in 2026 serves on the Government, Labor, and Elections Committee and its Local Government, Government Operations and Ethics, and Labor subcommittees.
